name: Two-Level Sparse Voxel Grid Layout
aliases: Two-Level Sparse Voxel Grid Layout — BrickMap, BrickPool
definition: Stores a sparse voxel world using an outer grid of cells pointing to fixed-size inner bricks of packed voxels.
summary: Two-Level Sparse Voxel Grid Layout stores sparse voxel worlds using an outer grid of cells pointing to fixed-size inner bricks, offering predictable memory layout and simpler boundary checks compared to hash-based alternatives.
